maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max pages
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape. 0 means no limit.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: How many links deep to follow from the start URLs. 0 scrapes only the start URLs.

sameDomainOnly.title: Stay on the same domain
sameDomainOnly.description: Only follow links on the same hostname as the page they were found on.

includeLinks.title: Include links in output
includeLinks.description: Store the full list of absolute links found on each page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Leave empty to crawl without a proxy.
